subject: general
question: How many nuclear power plants has the United States agreed to set-up in India to strengthen bilateral security and civil nuclear cooperation between the two nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**six.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **India and the US** said they have agreed to build **six American nuclear power plants in India.**
 
• It is a boost to bilateral civil nuclear energy cooperation.
 
• They committed to strengthening bilateral security and civil nuclear cooperation.
 
• **India and the US signed a historic agreement to cooperate in the civil nuclear energy sector in October 2008.**
 
• The deal gave a fillip to bilateral ties, which have been on an upswing since.
 
• India plans to triple its nuclear capacity by 2024 to wean Asia's third-largest economy off polluting fossil fuels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian government is reportedly planning to build** ten nuclear power plants** in ‘fleet mode’ in the country over the next three years.
 
• The FPC is planned for next year at the **700MW Kaiga atomic power station**, which is located in the Indian state of Karnataka.
 
• India currently operates a total of **22 nuclear reactors**, with more than **6.7GW of combined capacity.**
 
• In 2017, the government gave approval to the **Nuclear Power Corporation of India (NPCIL).**
 
• It approved to build of ten units of locally-designed pressurised heavy water reactors (PHWR), each with 700MW of capacity.
